name: DRY STORAGE CABINET
desc: Premium Microprocessor-Controlled Dehumidify Dry Storage Cabinet engineered for precise climate preservation of moisture-sensitive devices. Features a 435-liter internal capacity and an auto-regenerated electronic Zeolite desiccant system.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS DRY STORAGE CABINET is a precision-engineered, microprocessor-controlled dehumidification system designed to safeguard moisture-sensitive materials by maintaining a user-selectable relative humidity between 20% and 50% RH. Its core principle relies on an auto-regenerated electronic Zeolite desiccant engine: a high-efficiency zeolite molecular sieve adsorbs water vapor from the chamber air, while an integrated thermal regeneration cycle periodically drives off the trapped moisture, ensuring continuous, maintenance-free dry storage. A high-precision electronic humidity-cum-temperature sensor feeds real-time data to an advanced PID-based digital controller, which modulates the desiccant cycle to hold the setpoint within ±3.0% RH and ±1.0°C. This controlled microclimate is critical for doctors and clinical laboratories storing moisture-sensitive diagnostic kits, lyophilized reagents, PCR master mixes, and hygroscopic pharmaceutical powders; for B.Sc/M.Sc students and PhD researchers preserving anhydrous salts such as calcium chloride and magnesium sulfate, analytical reference standards, desiccated biological specimens, and moisture-sensitive ELISA reagents; and for chemists and electronics engineers protecting PCB assemblies, ICs, optical lenses, and other ESD-sensitive components from hydrolytic degradation, oxidation, and delamination. The cabinet supports compliance with moisture-sensitive device handling guidelines such as IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033 and general laboratory QA/QC practices under ISO 9001 and ASTM E104 humidity control references.
sop: Ensure the cabinet is placed on a level floor, all caster wheels are locked, and the power cord is connected to a 220 V, 50 Hz, single-phase supply.
Before first use or after prolonged shutdown, open the door and allow the chamber to equilibrate to ambient conditions; wipe the interior with a dry, lint-free cloth.
Close the door firmly to engage the continuous airtight magnetic rubber gasket seal and secure the door lock if required.
Switch ON the main power supply and turn on the cabinet power switch.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., 25% RH or 30% RH).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Allow the microprocessor controller to run the auto-regeneration zeolite desiccant cycle until the display stabilizes at the setpoint within ±3.0% RH.
Before loading, ensure hands are clean and use an ESD wrist strap if storing static-sensitive devices; place items on shelves with adequate spacing for air circulation.
Close the door immediately after loading; avoid frequent or prolonged door openings to prevent moisture ingress.
Monitor the display periodically; if a door open alarm or high humidity alarm activates, close the door and allow the cabinet to recover to the setpoint.

Safety Warning: Do not store volatile flammable solvents, strong oxidizing acids, or unsealed corrosive chemicals inside the cabinet, as the desiccant and electronic components may be damaged and hazardous vapors can accumulate; always keep containers tightly sealed and consult the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) before storage.
